subject: CAIQ: sampling plan & evidence validation for upcoming review
messages:
From: Claire Benson <claire@cyberassure.io>

Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@stratusbank.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ sampling request for Q2 evidence

Hi Soojin / Laura,

Thanks again for agreeing to support Stratus Bank's CAIQ review next week. We need a short sampling plan and confirmation of where the evidence will be pulled from for the following control families: IAM, Logging & Monitoring, Key Management, and Change Control. Ideally we get:

- A short description of the sampling approach (statistical vs stratified)
- The time window for log samples (e.g., last 90 days)
- Which environments are in-scope (prod, staging, sandbox)
- Owner names for each evidence artifact
- A small example artifact for each control type (screenshot or runbook)

Deliverable needed by COB 2027-04-13 so the reviewer can prep. We expect roughly 20-40 samples per control depending on risk level.

Could you attach any queries/scripts we should run to reproduce log pulls?

Best,
Claire Benson
Senior Assessor | CyberAssure Audit Services

--
Attachment: assessment_scope.pdf (PDF stub, 312KB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Claire Benson <claire@cyberassure.io>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@stratusbank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T10:01:14-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ sampling request for Q2 evidence

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear ask. We're proposing a stratified sampling approach to balance reviewer confidence with operational effort. High-level plan (attached as caiq_sampling_plan_v1.xlsx):

- Sampling approach: stratified by control-criticality and environment (prod/staging). For high-risk controls (IAM, Key Mgmt) we'll do 30 samples; for lower-risk logging controls we'll target 20.
- Time window: default = last 90 days; for any high-severity alerts we'll include targeted recent windows (last 30 days).
- Environments: prod is primary; staging included for change control evidence if prod artifacts insufficient. Sandbox excluded unless requested.
- Evidence types: config screenshots, runbook excerpts, S3 bucket access logs, CloudTrail queries (see log_sampling_query.sql).
- Owners: Rishi (IAM + Key Mgmt), Marcus (Logging queries & exports), Laura (Change Control artifacts).

I attached the initial plan and the SQL we use to extract CloudTrail events (log_sampling_query.sql). We'll include a one-off example artifact for each control type in the evidence bundle.

Do you want us to mask any PII in the log samples before delivery? We can provide both masked and raw samples under a secure transfer if needed.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: CAIQ sampling request for Q2 evidence — revised plan and timeline

Team / Claire — updated plan below; I've run the queries against prod and staging to validate counts.

- Time window: last 90 days (2027-01-12 to 2027-04-11) for all controls by default.
- Sample counts: IAM & Key Mgmt = 30 samples each (spread across 3 weeks), Logging controls = 20 samples, Change Control = 25 samples (mix of PRs and approved runbooks).
- Environments: prod prioritized (70% of samples), staging (30%) for change control.
- Sampling method: stratified random sampling to capture weekdays and weekends; we include at least two samples from peak traffic days.
- Evidence pulls: Marcus will export CloudTrail + App logs using log_sampling_query.sql (attached). Rishi will export KMS rotation history and IAM role change events. Laura will collect signed runbook and change approvals.
- Delivery: tarball + index file (evidence-checklist.pdf) delivered to secure SFTP by 2027-04-13 18:00 PT.

Notes/controls called out: CSA CCM v4.0 controls mapped in the plan: IAM-1, IAM-2, LOG-1, LOG-2, CHG-1, CHG-3, KMS-1. We'll include an index mapping artifact IDs to CSA control IDs.
